summary: Short, steep residential kerb with homes 12-16 m away; narrow street.
reasons: Homes 12-16 m on the same side

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling 16 m away at the start; non-dwelling buildings 11-17 m; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; one car parked on the opposite kerb, so the lane is narrow with a fence line beside the kerb.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P parking, Mon-Fri 9am-4pm; nothing restricts evenings or overnight.

flags: Dwellings 12-16 m away on the street's own side
Brisbane River 191 m away, low ground about 30 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the south end; open to the afternoon sun further north.

best_section.where: Southern end of Glasnevin Street west kerb, under the trees
